name: Saginomiya Hiyori
source: Hiyori is a first-year transfer student at Ren's school. She is the only daughter of the distinguished Saginomiya family. Hiyori is friendly and the type that goes headlong at what she has decided to do despite her childish appearance. For some reason, she has an unusual love for natto.
translation: Hiyori is a first-year transfer student at Ren's school. She is the only daughter of the distinguished Saginomiya family. Hiyori is friendly and the type that goes headlong at what she has decided to do despite her childish appearance. For some reason, she has an unusual love for natto.
